title: Image Cropping and Resizing Test Cases Companion
description: Runnable Pillow-based crop/resize pipeline (EXIF normalization, bounds and min-size clamping, aspect-ratio lock, zoom coordinate mapping, alpha-aware export, animated GIF frame cropping, batch resize) with a pytest suite mapped to the Image Cropping and Resizing Test Cases resource, plus a Playwright spec and a Gherkin feature for the browser flow.
